Requires line of sight for 3 full turns; can only move during. **On a 10+**, slake 3 Hunger. **On a 12+**, slake 4 Hunger and take +2 Forward; target subdued as if experiencing the Kiss.

entries.name: Marionette
entries.snippet: **When you seize control of the blood inside a mortal's body**, make a Hunger Check, roll +Blood, and mark 2 Stains. Must have previously tasted target's blood. **On a 10+**, full control for 3 turns; doing anything requiring a roll severs the connection.

entries.name: Blood Aegis
entries.snippet: **When you command your Vitae to form a hovering shield**, gain +1 Hunger. Gain 5 Temporary Harm capacity. Reinforce at 1 Hunger Check per +5, max pool of {{bp*3}}. Lasts 1 scene or until depleted.

entries.name: Fulminating Vitae
entries.snippet: **When you bleed into a small sealed container and prime it to detonate**, gain +2 Hunger. Armed until dawn. Thrown via **Dirty Your Claws**, replacing usual effects. **On a 10+**, 2 + {{blood}} Agg. Harm to every Kindred within Close Range (mortals take Sup. instead).

entries.name: Baal's Caress
entries.snippet: **When you transmute your Vitae into lethal neurotoxin**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. Same delivery as ***Scorpion's Touch***. **On a 10+**, envenomed attacks deal +5 Agg. Harm for the scene. Mortals die in seconds; Kindred who take Agg. must **Stay Chill** when they next sleep or enter indefinite Torpor.

entries.name: Cauldron of Blood
entries.snippet: **When you press your palm against a creature's skin and boil their blood** (in combat, requires successful **Dirty Your Claws** first), gain +1 Hunger, mark 1 Stain, and roll +Blood. **On a 10+**, Agg. Harm equal to 2 + {{blood}}; surviving Kindred immediately Frenzy and flee. Mortals die.

entries.name: Reclamation of Vitae
entries.snippet: **When you command the Vitae in your Ghouls to return**, mark 1 Stain per Ghoul targeted. No roll, distance irrelevant. Per Ghoul: slake 2 Hunger and gain +1 Ongoing (max +5) to all Discipline rolls for the scene. Each targeted Ghoul takes 5 Agg. Harm; survivors lose their Bond and Ghoul status.

entries.name: Rapid Reflexes
entries.snippet: **You get 2 Free Actions per turn instead of 1.** Always-active Armor equal to {{bp}} against ranged projectiles (bullets, arrows, thrown weapons/objects).

entries.name: Traversal
entries.snippet: **When you throw yourself at a surface that shouldn't support lateral movement**, make a Hunger Check. For {{bp}} turns, run or climb along any surface (walls, ceilings, glass, water with running start, whatever). When the effect ends, gravity resumes; plan accordingly.

entries.name: Fleetness
entries.snippet: **Whenever you move** (via **Reposition**, **Slip Away**, normal Movement, or any non-Celerity means), travel 1 additional Range band beyond normal. Does not stack with other Celerity Powers.

entries.name: Rush Job
entries.snippet: **When you burn Vitae to multitask at ludicrous speed**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. **On a 10+**, for the rest of the scene you can handle two physically demanding tasks simultaneously (Discipline Power + Basic Move, etc.); you choose which task gets -2 Forward.

entries.name: A Thousand Cuts
entries.snippet: **When you unleash a flurry of strikes with claws or an edged weapon**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. **On a 10+**, target takes Sup. Harm equal to 3 + {{blood}}. **On a 12+**, roll {{bp}}d6 for total Harm instead. Regardless of result, every vampire within Close Range at 3+ Hunger must **Stay Chill** or Frenzy from the blood spray.

entries.name: Blink
entries.snippet: **When you swoop to a point up to 2 Range bands away**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. Replaces your Movement in combat. **On a 10+**, arrive exactly where intended with +1 Forward.

entries.name: Weaving
entries.snippet: **When you overclock your reflexes to perceive projectiles in slow motion**, make a Hunger Check with Disadvantage. For the rest of the scene, you are immune to ranged projectiles entirely. Does not affect supernatural ranged attacks.

entries.name: Blurred Momentum
entries.snippet: **When you commit to sustained maximum speed**, make a Hunger Check. While active, any offensive Move against you requires a **10+** to connect; anything less misses. Costs 1 additional Hunger Check at the start of each of your turns. If the Hunger cost pushes you to 5 Hunger and you Frenzy, the Beast inherits your speed.

entries.name: Draught of Elegance
entries.snippet: **When you let someone drink directly from you**, make a Hunger Check with Disadvantage. The drinker gains all Level 1 Celerity Powers until the next dawn. For vampires, fades when they next **Feed** or reach 5 Hunger. Counts as 1 exchange toward a Blood Bond.

entries.name: Faster Than Light
entries.snippet: **Your *Blink* can now pass through any barrier that light passes through** (windows, curtains, fences, chain-link, glass). **On a 10+** through fire or sunlight, you pass unharmed.

entries.name: Unerring Aim
entries.snippet: **When you *Dirty Your Claws* with a ranged weapon**, treat a **6-** as **7–9**. You never miss outright.

entries.name: Unseen Strike
entries.snippet: **When you *Blink* to close directly on an enemy**, your arrival is an Ambush; you strike before they react. After acting, you may immediately **Slip Away** as part of the same burst.

entries.name: Lightning Strike
entries.snippet: **When you commit full supernatural speed to a single devastating blow**, make a Hunger Check. Double the Harm you would deal and add 5. Applies to any melee attack or offensive Discipline Power at Hand Range. A target with equal-or-higher BP can Hunger Check to negate the bonus (base attack still lands).

entries.name: Split Second
entries.snippet: **When the Storyteller begins describing an incoming threat, disaster, or enemy Ambush**, make a Hunger Check to act first. You take a full turn before the threat resolves or enemies act. Must call it during the narration or the moment passes.

entries.name: Cypher Lingua
entries.snippet: **When you spend at least one scene of focused exposure to a mortal language**, you permanently learn whatever components you were exposed to (reading a manuscript grants literacy; listening to a speaker grants fluency). **When you encounter supernatural writing or symbols**, make a Hunger Check and roll the stat the Storyteller assigns.

entries.name: Rancorous Redress
entries.snippet: 1/Scene, **when you suffer Harm that you inflicted on yourself** (deliberate or as a Power/Sacrament cost), take +{{bp@min:1}} Forward on your next Discipline roll.

entries.name: Duress
entries.snippet: **When you pull the weight of the Outer Dark into the air around you**, make 1 Hunger Check per Discipline user within Close Range, then roll +Shadow. While active, all Discipline rolls within Close Range (including yours) have Disadvantage. **On a 10+**, persists until you drop it, leave, or scene ends. **On a 6-**, only you have Disadvantage for the scene.

entries.name: Surge of Tenacity
entries.snippet: **When you activate a Blood Surge**, every ally within Close Range gains Advantage on their next +Blood or +Shadow roll this scene.

entries.name: Gnaw
entries.snippet: **When you release your parasitic swarm**, take 1 Sup. Harm (Ignore-Armor), make a Hunger Check, and roll +Blood. Swarm pursues the designated target for 3 turns, dealing 1 Sup. Harm/turn. **On a 6-**, the swarm targets a random creature in Close Range instead (or you, if nobody else is near).

entries.name: Kiss of the Molochim
entries.snippet: **When you successfully *Feed* on someone who could threaten you or your allies**, you may forfeit all **Feeding** benefits to mark them. For {{humanity}} nights, the target has Disadvantage on all aggression rolls toward you or your Coterie. Ends if you or an ally provokes/attacks the target; they become immune for the story.

entries.name: Incite Sin
entries.snippet: **When someone ingests your Vitae**, intrusive thoughts nudge them toward their worst impulses until dawn. You can also trigger this deliberately: **when your blood touches someone's bare skin**, make a Hunger Check. **If they act against their moral code/Convictions while affected**, both of you gain Ongoing equal to whichever BP is higher (yours or theirs, minimum 1) on all rolls until scene ends.

entries.name: Vampiric Vehemence
entries.snippet: **When you channel infernal energy into a melee weapon**, make a Hunger Check. Your next swing projects as a ranged attack within Far Range, dealing normal Harm plus the Hunger Check d6 result. One charge, one shot.

entries.name: Knight of Teeth
entries.snippet: **When you reshape your own flesh into weapons**, declare up to {{bp}} weapons, take 2 Sup. Harm per weapon (Ignore-Armor), make a Hunger Check, and roll +Blood. All deal Agg. Harm to mortals. **On a 12+**, 4-Harm each. **On a 10+**, 3-Harm. **On a 6-**, 1-Harm each and the creation Harm becomes Agg. Weapons last until scene ends or dismissed.

entries.name: Sealing Antiphon
entries.snippet: **When someone activates a Discipline Power in your presence and you whisper a sealing hymn**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. A talisman appears; while you hold it, the target cannot use that Power. **On a 12+**, seal is silent. **On a 10+**, target knows you did it. **On a 6-**, one of your Powers is sealed instead and the talisman appears on the target. Lasts until dawn or target reclaims it. Humanity gate: 5 or lower.

entries.name: Carrion Banquet
entries.snippet: **When you slay a living creature of at least human size**, make a Hunger Check to detonate the corpse. Vampires in the splash zone (Close Range) may **Feed** reactively: **on a 7+**, slake 1 Hunger (no other benefits). Masquerade Clock +2 if mortals witness it.

entries.name: Coiling Spite
entries.snippet: **When you crack open the door to the Outer Dark in a psychic lash**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. Every supernatural creature except you within Close Range (including allies) takes 3 Agg. Harm (Ignore-Armor); mortals are unaffected. **On a 12+**, creatures hit must **Stay Chill** or buckle, and you gain Temporary Harm capacity equal to total Harm dealt to those who fail.

entries.name: Eternal Damnation
entries.snippet: **When you lock eyes with someone who is already wounded and speak a curse**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. All marked Harm on the target cannot be healed while the curse holds. **On a 12+**, indefinite. **On a 10+**, lasts {{bp*2}} nights. **On a 6-**, your own marked Harm can't be healed for {{bp}} nights.

entries.name: Parasitic Bore
entries.snippet: **When you launch a parasitoid organism at a target**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. **On a 10+**, bores in by start of target's next turn; **on a 12+**, instantly. **On a 6-**, it bores into you instead. Once burrowed, gorges for up to 3 turns (vampires gain +1 Hunger/turn, mortals take 1 Agg. Harm/turn). Recall it to slake Hunger equal to turns consumed.

entries.name: Balefire Ignition
entries.snippet: **When you expose your Vitae to open air and speak the ignition words**, gain +1 Hunger (free if you've taken Harm this scene). Two Balefire whips extend from your wrists; unarmed **Dirty Your Claws** targets anyone within Close Range and deals 3 + {{blood}} Agg. Harm. Targets hit ignite for 1 Agg. Harm/turn. Slaying someone with Balefire slakes 1 Hunger. Lasts for scene.

entries.name: Nightmare Theatre
entries.snippet: **When you reach into a target's mind and dredge their worst fears**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. Locks out all other Discipline Powers while active. **On a 10+**, target suffers -{{bp}} Ongoing and 1 Agg. Harm/turn while you concentrate. **On a 12+**, also 3 + {{humanity-lost}} Agg. Harm upfront. **On a 6-**, channel reverses: you take 3 Agg. Harm. Against unprepared mortals, treat **6-** as **7–9**.

entries.name: Hell Warden
entries.snippet: **When you seal every exit in an enclosed space**, make 2 Hunger Checks and roll +Demeanor. Unprepared mortals cannot escape. Supernatural creatures must **Catch the Scent** to find real exits, then roll +Resolve (**7+**) to force one open. **On a 12+**, they have Disadvantage on both rolls. **On a 6-**, you are subject to your own warding. Lasts until you leave or choose to end it.

entries.name: Crown of the Lost Clan
entries.snippet: **While your *Dark Sacrament* is dedicated to the Outer Dark**: perceive Wraiths, Shades, ghosts, and incorporeal entities without Powers; sense Blood Sorcery, Oblivion, or Daimonion activations within Distant Range; gain +{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing on all social rolls with entities not native to the mortal realm. Goes dormant if you change dedication.

entries.name: Sanguine Bond
entries.snippet: **When you lock eyes with a target and forge a link between your wounds and theirs**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Resolve. All Harm you heal is inflicted on the target as the same type. **On a 12+**, all your current Harm is instantly transferred (mark 1 Stain if lethal). **On a 10+**, bond lasts until dawn. **On a 6-**, the bond reverses: target's healing mirrors as Harm onto you until dawn.

entries.name: Soul Swap
entries.snippet: **When you silently switch your supernatural aura with a target's**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. Anyone reading supernatural identity sees you as the target and vice versa; overrides ***Hidden Devil***. Lasts until dawn. **On a 12+**, undetectable. **On a 10+**, target can only detect something wrong on a **12+** Auspex check on themselves. **On a 6-**, swap fails and the target knows exactly what you are.

entries.name: Mitosis
entries.snippet: **When you spend a full uninterrupted scene tearing yourself in half**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood, then take {{humanity-lost}} Agg. Harm (Ignore-Armor). The duplicate has {{(max-hp/2)@rounddown}} max Harm, your stats, memories, and Powers up to Level 4. **On a 6-**, the duplicate believes it is the original and tries to replace you.

entries.name: Born Again
entries.snippet: **When you call upon the Outer Dark to claim mortals who ingested your Vitae since last dawn**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor. Chosen mortals transform into minor demons for the scene (not directly controllable; Ghouls survive, mortals die, mark 1 Stain each). **On a 12+**, demons inherit your stats and deal 3 + {{humanity-lost}} Agg. Harm. **On a 10+**, demons deal {{humanity-lost}} Agg. Harm. **On a 6-**, the demons attack everything, including you.

entries.name: Hell's Yawning Maw
entries.snippet: **When you rip open a portal to the Outer Dark**, make 2 Hunger Checks and roll +Blood or +Shadow (use higher). All creatures within Far Range except you take {{humanity-lost}} Agg. Harm. Those killed incubate Balefire Hellions ({{bp}} max Harm, 3 Agg. Harm, immune to Sup.; only sunlight/Holy). **On a 6-**, the rift is permanent until someone seals it.

entries.name: Cloud Memory
entries.snippet: **Your *Compel* can now target memories.** A simple "Forget" erases the target's last few minutes (1 scene or less), permanent and unrecoverable. Against supernatural creatures, still requires the usual ***Compel*** roll.

entries.name: Devotion
entries.snippet: Anyone under one of your Dominate Powers is shielded from other Dominate attempts. **When another vampire uses Dominate on a former target of yours**, their results are downgraded: **12+**/**10+** counts as **7–9**, and **7–9** counts as **6-**.

entries.name: Dementation
entries.snippet: **When you engage someone in conversation and thread your will between the words**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor. Sustained eye contact not required. **On a 10+**, Hold 3. **On a 7–9**, Hold 1. Spend Hold 1-for-1: target lashes out at someone, becomes irrationally paranoid, suffers a visible breakdown, or (mortal only) has a full psychotic episode for the scene. Spend 2 Hold to force a vampire into a Compulsion of your choice. **On a 6-**, you must **Stay Chill** or succumb to your own Compulsion.

entries.name: Domitor's Favor
entries.snippet: Blood Bonds you hold over mortals never degrade. Maintaining Bonds over Kindred requires half the normal effort/Vitae. If you and another vampire share a mutual Blood Bond and either has this Power, you both have +1 Ongoing to all rolls when acting together in the same scene.

entries.name: Mesmerize
entries.snippet: **When you hold someone's gaze and issue a series of clear, immediate commands**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Resolve. Commands must be immediately actionable, no conditional logic, no judgment calls. **On a 10+**, target completes commands flawlessly and has no memory afterward. **On a 7–9**, target obeys with 1 complication. **On a 6-**, commands collapse into painful noise; target clutches their skull, lashes out, and remembers your face and voice perfectly.

entries.name: The Stolen Voice
entries.snippet: **When you lock eyes with someone and command their silence**, make a Hunger Check. Against mortals, no roll needed; total silence is immediate. Against supernatural creatures, the target must **Stay Chill** to resist (Advantage if their BP exceeds yours). Their result determines depth: **on a 12+**, the Power reflects back onto you (**7–9** silencing for the scene). **On a 10+**, they resist entirely. **On a 7–9**, complete vocal and textual silencing for the scene (gestures/sign still work). **On a 6-**, total silence for the scene: no speech, no writing, no sounds of any kind.

entries.name: Submerged Directive
entries.snippet: Your ***Mesmerize*** commands can now include conditional triggers ("when X happens, do Y"). Only 1 directive per target. Lies dormant indefinitely until triggered, then executes as though freshly ***Mesmerized***. Target has no awareness of the embedded command until it activates.

entries.name: The Forgetful Mind
entries.snippet: **When you hold someone's gaze and carefully describe new memories to replace old ones**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Wits. Requires a full, uninterrupted scene. Rewrite scope scales with BP: BP 3 = 1 night, BP 4 = up to 1 month, BP 5 = unlimited. **On a 10+**, new memories are seamless and feel real; only hard contradictory evidence could unravel them. **On a 7–9**, rewrite works with 1 complication. **On a 6-**, target's mind fractures: they don't remember the old memories or the new ones, and the gap causes lasting paranoia or identity issues.

entries.name: Ancestral Dominion
entries.snippet: **When you command a vampire of your own Clan within Close Range**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. Requires neither eye contact nor spoken words; travels through the Blood itself. Target must have lower BP than yours. **On a 10+**, target obeys as though ***Mesmerized***. **On a 7–9**, command takes hold with 1 complication. **On a 6-**, target is unaffected and knows exactly who tried.

entries.name: Implant Suggestion
entries.snippet: **When you lock eyes and plant a desire, opinion, or impulse into someone's mind**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor. Changes what they *want*, not what they do; they act on the implanted desire using their own judgment. Radical changes to core beliefs impose Disadvantage. **On a 10+**, suggestion takes hold immediately and lasts for the scene; target believes it's their own. **On a 7–9**, works with 1 complication. **On a 6-**, target's psyche violently rejects the intrusion; social standing with those present is damaged.

entries.name: Rationalize
entries.snippet: Your Dominate victims believe everything they did under your command was entirely their own idea and defend their actions with full conviction. Only hard evidence or persistent, specific questioning can crack the illusion.

entries.name: Tabula Rasa
entries.snippet: **When you restrain a conscious target, lock their gaze, and systematically dismantle their identity**, make 3 Hunger Checks (if any push you to 5 Hunger, you Frenzy and the Power fails) and roll +Resolve during a full, uninterrupted scene. **On a 10+**, total mental erasure: memories, Convictions, Touchstones, all gone. Target retains stats, 1 random language, and Discipline access but nothing else. Permanent. **On a 7–9**, nearly complete with 1 complication. **On a 6-**, target's mind snaps shut; Botched Domination applies, target remembers everything and knows what you tried, -1 Ongoing for the scene. On any **7+**, gain Stains equal to 2x the target's BP (minimum 2).

entries.name: Lethe's Call
entries.snippet: Two modes. **Erasure by Time:** make 1 Hunger Check per week erased (up to 5 weeks). No roll needed; memories simply vanish. **Erasure by Topic:** **when you lock eyes and will a specific person or event out of their memory**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Wits. **On a 12+**, perfect erasure; unrecoverable by any means. **On a 10+**, thorough erasure; only supernatural investigation can detect traces. **On a 7–9**, surface memories gone but fragments persist. **On a 6-**, both you and the target suffer total amnesia of the current night up to this moment.

entries.name: Mass Manipulation
entries.snippet: Any of your Dominate Powers can now target a group instead of an individual. Everyone who can see your eyes and hear your voice is a valid target. Make one roll for the entire group. Standard BP Disadvantage applies if anyone in the group has higher BP than yours.

entries.name: Terminal Decree
entries.snippet: **Commands that would kill or seriously injure the target no longer fail automatically.** Works through ***Compel***, ***Mesmerize***, or any other Dominate Power; applies to Kindred and mortals. Using this Power costs 1 Humanity immediately. **Exception:** if the target has been given a fair trial and found guilty of a capital offense by a legitimate authority, the Humanity cost is waived.

entries.name: Toughness
entries.snippet: **When you brace yourself**, make a Hunger Check. Halve all incoming Sup. Harm (rounded down, min 1) for the scene. If caught off guard, activate reflexively on first hit, but that hit only gets -1; halving kicks in from the next onward.

entries.name: Unswayable Mind
entries.snippet: Add {{bp@min:1}} to any roll to **Stay Chill** or resist coercion, intimidation, or mental domination (Dominate, Presence, etc.). Stacks with Playbook Perks.

entries.name: Earth's Perseverance
entries.snippet: **When you plant your feet and will yourself immovable**, make a Hunger Check. Nothing can move you for the scene: shoves, explosions, supernatural knockback, all of it. Doesn't reduce Harm; choosing to move ends it.

entries.name: Invigorating Vitae
entries.snippet: **When you heal Sup. Harm at end of scene**, heal {{bp*2}} Sup. Harm instead of the usual amount. Creatures that drink your Vitae heal 3 Agg. Harm per Hunger Check's worth (counts as 1 Blood Bond exchange).

entries.name: Self-Assurance
entries.snippet: **When you successfully *Stay Chill* or resist coercion covered by *Unswayable Mind***, the creature that tried takes {{(bp/2)@roundup,min:1}} Agg. Harm. No roll, no Hunger Check, any distance.

entries.name: Calloused Soul
entries.snippet: **When you carry out a premeditated atrocity that ends at least three mortal lives**, mark 3 Stains (one may be mitigated by a Conviction). For the rest of the night, you cannot gain Stains, lose Humanity, or face a Remorse Check. Accidental kills don't qualify.

entries.name: Defy Bane
entries.snippet: **When you take Agg. Harm**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Resolve (can activate reactively). **On a 10+**, convert all Agg. Harm from this instance to Sup. **On a 7–9**, convert half (rounded down, min 1) to Sup.

entries.name: Fortify the Inner Façade
entries.snippet: Powers that read your thoughts, emotions, aura, or mental state fail outright if the Power's level is lower than your BP; if equal or higher, the reader rolls with Disadvantage. No protection against control (Dominate, Presence, Melpominee).

entries.name: Seal the Beast's Maw
entries.snippet: **When you force the Beast into silence**, make 2 Hunger Checks. For the scene, Compulsion penalties don't apply, you don't Frenzy at 5 Hunger, and you function as though Hunger were 0. If you gain 2+ Hunger during the scene, the Power ends and you have Disadvantage on all Frenzy resistance for the rest of the scene.

entries.name: Valeren
entries.snippet: **When you lay hands on an injured vampire** (Hand Range), make a Hunger Check and roll +Resolve. 1/target/night, cannot self-target. **On a 10+**, heal {{3+resolve}} Sup. Harm or convert 2 Agg. to Sup. Spending a full scene tending wounds skips the roll (auto **10+**).

entries.name: Draught of Endurance
entries.snippet: **When you let someone drink directly from you**, make a Hunger Check with Disadvantage. The drinker gains all Level 1 Fortitude Powers until dawn; for vampires, fades when they next **Feed** or hit 5 Hunger. Counts as 1 Blood Bond exchange.

entries.name: Gorgon's Scales
entries.snippet: **When you activate your Blood's defenses**, make a Hunger Check. Gain a Resonance-based resistance for the scene: Choleric crumbles stakes, Melancholic converts up to 4 fire/Bane Agg. to Sup., Phlegmatic blocks all mind-reading, Sanguine converts up to 4 sunlight Agg. to Sup. One Resonance at a time.

entries.name: Shatter
entries.snippet: **When you take a hit while *Toughness* is active**, make a Hunger Check. For the scene, anyone striking you in melee takes Sup. Harm equal to what you absorbed; melee weapons that accumulate reflected Harm equal to their Harm tag are destroyed.

entries.name: Flesh of Marble
entries.snippet: **When you flood your skin with the full power of your Blood**, make 2 Hunger Checks. For the scene, ignore the first source of physical Harm each turn (including fire, not sunlight). An opponent's **12+** bypasses this entirely.

entries.name: Meat Shields
entries.snippet: **When you draw on the fragile vitality of mortals around you**, make a Hunger Check with Disadvantage. Gain 3 Temporary Harm capacity per non-hostile mortal within Close Range (max 15), absorbing Harm before your own. Adjusts as mortals move in/out; vanishes at scene end.

entries.name: Prowess from Pain
entries.snippet: **While you have any Harm marked**, injuries carry no narrative consequences (broken limbs function normally). Each time you take Harm, gain a Forward bonus to your next physical roll equal to the Harm taken (max +5).

entries.name: Cognitive Dissonance
entries.snippet: **When you sing along with your Inner Song** (Free Action to start/stop), up to {{bp@min:1}} targets within Far Range suffer -1 Ongoing to all rolls while you keep singing and they can hear you. Can't use other vocal Discipline Powers while active; ends if you take Harm equal to or greater than your BP.

entries.name: Distorted Voice
entries.snippet: You can freely alter your voice in any way (no roll). **When you mimic a specific individual's voice**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor. **On a 10+**, flawless; anyone who knows the voice is fooled.

entries.name: Convincing Affect
entries.snippet: **When you vocalize with deliberate emotional intent**, make Hunger Checks equal to intensity (1 Fleeting, 2 Intense, 3 Acute) and roll +Demeanor. Instill one Resonance Humor in a target; their blood carries that Resonance at the chosen intensity until dawn or until someone **Feeds** on them. **On a 10+**, clean and unnoticed.

entries.name: Piercing Wail
entries.snippet: **When you unleash a devastating sonic blast**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. Deals {{2+blood+demeanor}} Sup. Harm to everyone and everything within Close Range, plus -1 Forward. Daughters of Cacophony and their belongings are immune.

entries.name: Distraction
entries.snippet: **When you fill the air with continuous vocalization**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor. Mortals within Close Range are entranced (-3 Ongoing to noticing anything else); supernatural creatures with BP equal to or lower than yours are similarly affected. **On a 10+**, only physical violence breaks the trance.

entries.name: Phantom Voice
entries.snippet: **When you reach out to someone you've spoken to for at least 1 scene**, make Hunger Checks equal to the scenes you want the link to last (max 5). Two-way conversation at any distance, heard as if beside them. Range scales with BP.

entries.name: Invigorating Display
entries.snippet: **When you perform for a crowd of at least ten mortals for the majority of a scene**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor. **On a 10+**, choose a Resonance Humor and gain Intense Resonance (2 Advantages); may distribute to Coterie witnesses. Resonance from a live show, not a corpse.

entries.name: Lingering Echo
entries.snippet: **When you vocalize into a space and leave an echo**, make Hunger Checks equal to the nights you want it to persist (no limit) and roll +Resolve. Specify a trigger; when triggered, plays your voice within Close Range. You may embed any Discipline Power you possess (doubles Hunger cost); it activates as if you were present.

entries.name: Shattering Crescendo
entries.snippet: Permanently upgrades ***Piercing Wail*** to {{4+blood+demeanor}} Agg. Harm. Shatters glass, cracks stone, buckles metal; mortal heads explode on contact.

entries.name: Psychic Scream
entries.snippet: **Your Melpominee Powers no longer require targets to physically hear you.** Sound travels directly into the mind, bypassing deafness, earplugs, soundproofing, and supernatural silence.

entries.name: Virtuosa
entries.snippet: Any single-target Melpominee Power can now affect up to {{bp@min:1}} targets. **You can maintain up to 2 vocal-based Powers simultaneously** (even from different Disciplines).

entries.name: Ensconce
entries.snippet: Supernaturally conceal up to {{bp@min:1}} small (one-hand) objects on your person. Mortals won't notice them, even during pat-downs; objects must have some physical concealment (pocketed, palmed, etc.). ***Sense the Unseen*** detects them.

entries.name: Mask of a Thousand Faces
entries.snippet: **When you disguise yourself as a forgettable face**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. Your features blur into someone who belongs; move and interact freely. **On a 10+**, anyone trying to see through it rolls with a Forward penalty equal to your BP; lasts 1 scene.

entries.name: Mask of Ages
entries.snippet: **When you shift your apparent age**, make a Hunger Check. Project any plausible human age until dawn. Gain a Forward bonus equal to your BP to any roll where projected age helps. ***Sense the Unseen*** sees through it.

entries.name: Silence of Death
entries.snippet: **When you cloak yourself in silence**, make a Hunger Check (free if you just killed a creature). For the scene, you produce no sound: footsteps, gunshots, **Feeding** sounds, all muted. Doesn't silence external sounds (slamming doors, dropped objects) or fool electronic audio equipment.

entries.name: Cache
entries.snippet: **When you touch an object and walk away**, make a Hunger Check. The object stays hidden without you carrying it (must fit ***Ensconce*** size). Lasts the scene; one more Hunger Check extends it until dawn. ***Sense the Unseen*** detects it.

entries.name: Doubletalk
entries.snippet: **1/Scene, say one thing while secretly conveying a completely different message to a single intended listener.** Bystanders hear only what you actually said; secret message limited to one mortal breath's length.

entries.name: Hallucination
entries.snippet: **When you conjure a hallucination targeting a single sense**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. **On a 10+**, witnesses are disoriented, taking -2 Forward. Can never be recorded or transmitted.

entries.name: Unseen Passage
entries.snippet: **After you've successfully *Slipped Away* or activated *Cloak of Shadows***, make a Hunger Check to remain hidden while moving freely for the scene. Walk, run, climb; just don't speak above a whisper or force observers to acknowledge you.

entries.name: Fata Morgana
entries.snippet: **When you project a multi-sensory illusion**, make 1–3 Hunger Checks (scaling from one room to a full building) and roll +Shadow. Illusions add to reality (can't mask objects, block sight, or deal Harm; not recordable). **On a 10+**, flawless for the scene; supernatural creatures roll with a Forward penalty equal to your BP to disbelieve.

entries.name: Ghost in the Machine
entries.snippet: **Your Obfuscate extends through electronic media; live feeds are affected like human observers.** Recordings taken during active Obfuscation are degraded (-{{bp}} Ongoing to identify you from footage). Advantage on any roll to circumvent automated surveillance.

entries.name: Guise of the Departed
entries.snippet: **When you spend a full scene caressing a corpse dead less than a week**, make a Hunger Check. Steal their appearance, bearing, and mannerisms until dawn. ***Sense the Unseen*** pierces it; how well it fools people who knew the deceased depends on a hidden +Shadow roll.

entries.name: Mask of Isolation
entries.snippet: **When you force facial mesmerism onto an unwilling subject**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. Target's face becomes forgettable; even close friends look right through them. **On a 10+**, lasts the night; target is unrecognizable to everyone, including themselves.

entries.name: Conceal
entries.snippet: **When you touch an object or area and will it to become forgettable**, make Hunger Checks equal to the number of nights and roll +Wits. Minds refuse to register it (max size: two-story house); occupants inside are concealed too. **On a 10+**, only ***Sense the Unseen*** or equivalent can detect it.

entries.name: Mental Maze
entries.snippet: **When you lock eyes with someone and twist their sense of direction**, make 1–3 Hunger Checks (scaling from a building to an outdoor area). Mortals are trapped for 1 night. Against supernatural creatures, roll +Shadow; **on a 10+**, target wastes a full scene escaping and takes 2 Sup. Willpower Harm.

entries.name: Mind Masque
entries.snippet: **When you craft a false psychic persona**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Wits. Anyone using supernatural abilities to read your aura, thoughts, or emotions encounters the mask instead. **On a 10+**, flawless for the scene with no indication it's fabricated.

entries.name: Seclusion
entries.snippet: **When you lock eyes with someone and sever their connection to all creatures**, they cannot perceive any living or undead being. Duration scales with Hunger Checks: 1 for scene, 2 for night, 3 for week, 4 for year and a day, 5 for indefinitely. Harm breaks the effect for 1 scene, then it reasserts.

entries.name: Cloak the Coterie
entries.snippet: **When you use any Obfuscate Power**, make 1 additional Hunger Check with Disadvantage to extend it to your entire Coterie. Members can still perceive each other; if you are revealed, everyone is revealed, but a single member being spotted doesn't break the rest.

entries.name: Impostor's Guise
entries.snippet: **When you reshape your presence to mimic a specific person**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. **On a 10+**, excellent; close contacts sense something slightly off but can't identify it.

entries.name: Vanish
entries.snippet: You no longer need to **Slip Away** or be hidden before activating ***Cloak of Shadows*** or ***Unseen Passage***. Disappear mid-conversation, mid-eye-contact; mortals question whether you were there at all. 1/Scene unless in your Haven.

entries.name: Ashes to Ashes
entries.snippet: **When you press your palm to a corpse and force Vitae into it**, gain +1 Hunger. Over 30 seconds the body dissolves into fine ash; nothing forensically useful remains. Works on any mortal corpse, fresh or ancient; not on vampires or supernaturally animated bodies.

entries.name: The Binding Fetter
entries.snippet: **While *Abyssal Sight* is active**, you can also perceive Fetters anchoring a ghost. Once identified, gain +{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all social, investigative, and Discipline rolls involving that ghost.

entries.name: Shadow Cloak
entries.snippet: **When you *Slip Away* or *Influence* a mortal to intimidate while shrouded in darkness**, gain +{{bp@min:1}} Forward. If ***Abyssal Sight*** is active, ignore its social penalty for that **Influence** roll.

entries.name: Arms of Ahriman
entries.snippet: **When you reach into a shadow and drag tendrils of darkness into the open**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. Arms extend to Close Range (Far at BP 4+), seize up to 2 targets, and restrain them. Free Action each turn to slam a restrained target for 2 Sup. Harm. **On a 10+**, targets must spend a full turn to **Slip Away** to break free.

entries.name: Fatal Prediction
entries.snippet: **When you study a mortal from a distance and weave entropy around their fate**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Wits. Over 24 hours, mundane-seeming accidents deliver up to 3 Agg. Harm; only affects mortals/Ghouls. **On a 6-**, entropy rebounds on you instead.

entries.name: Shadow Perspective
entries.snippet: **You can see and hear through any shadow within line of sight** as if lurking inside it while still perceiving your normal surroundings. Undetectable except by ***Sense the Unseen***; shift awareness between shadows freely, including your ***Umbral Sphere*** if active.

entries.name: Umbral Sphere
entries.snippet: **When you exhale darkness into existence around you**, make a Hunger Check. For the scene, project a supernatural shadow filling Close Range (Far at BP 4+) that negates Light Sensitivity Disadvantage for Oblivion Powers and obscures vision for anyone who can't see through supernatural darkness. Direct sunlight/strong UV dispels it.

entries.name: Where the Veil Thins
entries.snippet: **When you press your awareness against the boundary between living and dead**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. The Storyteller reveals local Veil density (Impenetrable through Absent); Thin locations grant +1 Ongoing, Frayed/Absent grant +2 Ongoing to Ceremony rolls. **On a 10+**, also learn the general cause.

entries.name: Aura of Decay
entries.snippet: **When you let Abyssal entropy seep through your skin**, make 3 Hunger Checks. For the scene, everything within Close Range rots: living creatures take {{bp}} Sup. Harm gradually (untreatable while active). You take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all social rolls for the duration.

entries.name: Passion Feast
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from a passionate or benevolent spirit**, mark 1 Stain, make a Hunger Check, and roll with your normal **Feed** stat. **On a 10+**, slake 2 Hunger; ghost loses the consumed passion. **On a 6-**, slake 1 Hunger, take 2 Sup. Harm, and the ghost becomes a vengeful Spectre targeting you.

entries.name: Shade Servant
entries.snippet: **When you peel a piece of your shadow free and give it purpose**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. The Shade travels across surfaces, slips through cracks, follows mental commands, and returns information when merged back; destroyed by bright light/sunlight. **On a 10+**, lasts {{bp}} scenes at any distance.

entries.name: Touch of Oblivion
entries.snippet: **When you grip someone at Hand Range and channel withering entropy through your grasp**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. All tiers deal 3 Agg. Harm. **On a 10+**, also choose 1 crippling injury: wither a limb, crumple throat, rot senses, or add {{bp}} to the Harm instead. **On a 6-**, entropy reverses; take 3 Agg. Harm to the arm used, withered and useless for the night.

entries.name: Necrotic Plague
entries.snippet: **When you touch a mortal's skin and poison their blood with supernatural rot**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. Only affects mortals/Ghouls. **On a 10+**, infected for {{bp}} days, 2 Agg. Harm/day; curable by drinking Vitae. **On a 6-**, plague hits you instead: 2 Agg. Harm immediately plus 2 more at dawn.

entries.name: Profane the Sanctified
entries.snippet: **When you channel the Abyss against a person of genuine religious devotion**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. **On a 10+**, target takes 1 Agg. Harm per symbol of faith on their person; symbols tarnished, faith protections suppressed for the scene. **On a 6-**, you take 1 Agg. Harm per symbol on the target; their primary symbol sears into your forehead until you gain 1 Humanity.

entries.name: Stygian Shroud
entries.snippet: **When you extend your *Umbral Sphere* beyond its normal reach**, sound dies within it. Anyone inside without ***Abyssal Sight*** has -2 Ongoing to perception rolls, and mortals take 1 Sup. Harm/turn from the suffocating emptiness.

entries.name: Umbrous Clutch
entries.snippet: **When you lock eyes with a target and command their shadow to swallow them**, make a Hunger Check and mark 1 Stain. Target falls through their shadow and reappears at your feet. Unprepared mortals are catatonic for the scene; vampires pulled through must **Stay Chill** or Frenzy and flee.

entries.name: The Darkness Within
entries.snippet: **When you reach into a creature's shadow and rip out the darkest parts of their psyche**, make 2 Hunger Checks and roll +Shadow. **On a 7+**, a shadowy doppelganger erupts matching the host's stats, Disciplines, and max Harm, hostile only to its host until scene ends or one is destroyed. **On a 6-**, the entity turns on you instead.

entries.name: Shadow Step
entries.snippet: **When you step into a shadow large enough to cover you and step out of another**, make a Hunger Check. Teleport to any shadow within Distant Range and line of sight; one willing passenger at no extra cost (non-Oblivion passengers take 1 Sup. Harm). **When dragging an unwilling creature**, roll +Shadow. **On a 6-**, you arrive fine; they vanish permanently, and you mark 5 Stains.

entries.name: Skuld Fulfilled
entries.snippet: **When you slather your palms and face in Vitae and recall a mortal or Ghoul's face**, gain 2 Hunger and roll +Shadow; distance irrelevant. **On a 10+**, a previously survived condition returns at worst severity. Against Ghouls, strips aging immunity and burns all Vitae. **On a 6-**, target gains permanent immunity to this Power and you take {{bp}} Agg. Harm and Stains.

entries.name: Tenebrous Avatar
entries.snippet: **When you dissolve into living darkness**, make 2 Hunger Checks and roll +Shadow. You become a 2D sentient shadow: slither across surfaces, pass through any non-sealed gap, immune to physical Harm (only fire/sunlight hurt you). Can envelop a creature to inflict ***Stygian Shroud*** effects and **Feed** from enveloped mortals through skin contact alone. **On a 10+**, lasts 1 scene.

entries.name: Withering Spirit
entries.snippet: **When you grasp a creature at Hand Range, lock eyes, and channel entropy into their soul**, make 2 Hunger Checks and roll +Shadow; mark 5 Stains (unless the kill aligns with a Conviction). Against mortals: {{bp*2}} Agg. Harm and killed targets cannot return as ghosts. Against vampires: consume {{bp}} Humanity (0 Humanity = Wight). **On a 6-**, entropy rebounds; take {{bp}} Agg. Harm, target unharmed.

entries.name: Lethal Body
entries.snippet: Your unarmed strikes when you **Dirty Your Claws** can deal Agg. Harm to mortals and carry the Ignore BP-Armor tag, bypassing {{bp}}-Armor. Stacks with ***Brutality***, ***Stone Hide***, and everything else.

entries.name: Uncanny Grip
entries.snippet: Climb any non-metallic surface by forcing fingers and toes into it like pitons; no roll required. Hang indefinitely from walls or ceilings (ceiling requires bare feet). Leaves permanent parallel gouges in surfaces.

entries.name: Prowess
entries.snippet: **When you channel your Blood into raw physical might**, make a Hunger Check. For the scene, unarmed strikes deal Harm equal to {{blood*2}}, and all feats of raw strength get the same doubled bonus. Stacks with ***Brutality*** and other Harm modifiers.

entries.name: Relentless Grasp
entries.snippet: **When someone tries to break free of your grip, knock you off a surface, or wrench something from your hands**, mortals simply cannot escape. Against supernatural creatures, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. **On a 10+**, grip is absolute. **On a 6-**, they break free with Advantage on their next action.

entries.name: Brutal Feed
entries.snippet: **When you roll a 12+ on *Dirty Your Claws***, activate ***Brutal Feed*** (no Hunger Check). Roll 1d6: slake that much Hunger and deal the same as extra Agg. Harm to the target. Against vampires, slake only half (rounded down, min 1) unless Banu Haqim or *Blood Leech* Predator Type. Masquerade Clock advances if mortals are present.

entries.name: Spark of Rage
entries.snippet: **When you lock eyes with someone and project primal aggression**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor. Automatic against unprepared mortals. **On a 10+** vs. supernatural: force them to attack a creature of your choice, or force them to **Stay Chill** or Frenzy. **On a 6-**, it rebounds and you must **Stay Chill** or Frenzy yourself.

entries.name: Wrecker
entries.snippet: **When you direct your strength against inanimate objects**, treat any **6-** as a **7–9**. You always accomplish the destruction; only the collateral varies.

entries.name: Crash Down
entries.snippet: **When you use *Soaring Leap* to slam into the ground**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. Everyone within Close Range takes 4 Sup. Harm. **On a 10+**, choose 2 extras: Shockwave (extend to Far Range), Impact (+{{bp}} Sup. Harm), Knockdown (prone, lose Movement), or Devastation (catastrophic structural damage). **On a 6-**, you take 2 Sup. Harm and end up prone. Masquerade Clock advances.

entries.name: Draught of Might
entries.snippet: **When you let someone drink directly from you**, make a Hunger Check with Disadvantage. The drinker gains all Level 1 Potence Powers until next dawn; for vampires, fades when they next **Feed** or reach 5 Hunger. Counts as 1 Blood Bond exchange.

entries.name: Subtle Hammer
entries.snippet: **Every part of your body projects full strength through minimal motion:** a flick carries the force of a punch, a nudge sends someone flying. The Storyteller should not advance Masquerade Clock for Potence feats performed this way unless someone is specifically watching. You automatically break free of any mundane physical restraint without visible effort.

entries.name: Earthshock
entries.snippet: **When you slam fist or foot into the ground**, make 2 Hunger Checks and roll +Blood. Everyone within Close Range is caught, including allies. **On a 10+**, {{blood+bp}} Sup. Harm; targets must **Stay Chill** or be knocked prone (warned allies get +2 Forward to resist). **On a 6-**, the ground beneath you breaks first; you take full Harm, buried and trapped. 1/scene only; Masquerade Clock advances.

entries.name: Fist of Caine
entries.snippet: **When you will the strength of the First Vampire into your bare hands**, make a Hunger Check. For the scene, unarmed strikes deal Agg. Harm to all creatures. Each time you slay an opponent by **Dirtying Your Claws**, spring to another enemy within Close Range and **Dirty Your Claws** again, chaining up to {{bp}} total **Dirty Your Claws** rolls.

entries.name: Eyes of the Serpent
entries.snippet: **When you catch someone's gaze and reveal slitted, serpentine pupils**, the target is frozen as long as you maintain eye contact (can speak quietly but can't move, act, or shout). Breaking eye contact or the target taking Harm ends it; one gaze at a time. No roll against most mortals.

entries.name: Lingering Kiss
entries.snippet: Mortals you **Feed** on become addicted to your Kiss, even if painful. They obsess and seek you out; fades over weeks without contact, but a single additional **Feeding** resets it. Advantage on all social rolls against mortals craving your Kiss.

entries.name: Electromagnetism
entries.snippet: Your Presence now transmits through live electronic media (phone calls, video chats, live streams). ***Awe/Daunt*** and ***Entrancement*** function through live feeds; recorded media does not work.

entries.name: Honeyed Words
entries.snippet: Your voice alone carries Presence. Use this Discipline's Perk and any Presence Power through a closed door, from hiding, or from anywhere within Close Range, as long as the target can hear and understand you. Does not work through electronics.

entries.name: Dread Gaze
entries.snippet: **When you bare your fangs to induce primal terror**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor. Mortals flee, freeze, or crumple (no roll). **On a 10+** vs. supernatural, target must **Stay Chill** with -{{bp}} Forward or succumb to fearful Frenzy and flee. **On a 6-**, the target Frenzies toward you as its sole focus; can't end until you escape or die.

entries.name: Irresistible Voice
entries.snippet: People find it difficult to interrupt you, walk away, or ignore you; they must **Stay Chill** or hang on your every word (affects anyone outside your Coterie with BP lower than yours).

entries.name: Passion Leech
entries.snippet: **When you spend a scene near an unaware mortal and slowly siphon their emotions**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor. **On a 10+**, gain all benefits of 10 Humanity until dawn (**Blush of Life**, warmth, beating heart, genuine emotions). **On a 6-**, the siphon reverses; feel nothing, -1 Ongoing to Demeanor rolls for the night.

entries.name: True Love's Face
entries.snippet: **When you reshape your appearance to match the person someone feels most strongly about** (grief, guilt, and hatred work too), make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor. **On a 10+**, flawless copy for the scene; Advantage on all social rolls with the target. **On a 6-**, grotesque distortion; 1 Stain for you, 1 for the target; target immune for the night.

entries.name: Entrancement
entries.snippet: **When you focus your supernatural allure on a single individual**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor. Target falls into rapt fascination for {{bp}} scenes; won't harm themselves or loved ones (asking ends it), and failing any social roll against them also ends it. **On a 10+**, Advantage on all social rolls against them. **On a 6-**, target is repulsed, sees through you, immune for the night.

entries.name: Inflame Desire
entries.snippet: **When you touch someone and amplify their existing desire**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor. Must know what the target currently wants; does not create new desires. **On a 10+**, target is consumed by desire for the scene, -2 Ongoing to rolls unrelated to pursuing it. **On a 6-**, your own Compulsion activates immediately.

entries.name: Suffuse the Edifice
entries.snippet: **While present in a building**, extend ***Awe***, ***Daunt***, or ***Majesty*** through the entire structure. Anyone inside or looking at it from outside is affected as if you stood before them. Outdoors, extends to Far Range instead.

entries.name: Wingman
entries.snippet: **When you touch a willing vampire and channel your Presence through them**, make 2 Hunger Checks. Your ally gains access to one of your Presence Powers until end of scene, using your BP for scaling. You cannot use the shared Power yourself while extended; one Power, one target at a time.

entries.name: Majesty
entries.snippet: **When you unleash the full force of your supernatural presence**, make Hunger Checks equal to the number of Range bands you wish to affect (1 for Intimate through 5 for Distant) and roll +Demeanor. Everyone who can perceive you cannot act against you: stare, kneel, or flee only. **On a 10+**, holds for the scene. **On a 6-**, it collapses and everyone in range becomes actively hostile.

entries.name: Summon
entries.snippet: **When you concentrate on individuals you've previously affected with a Presence Power or who have tasted your Vitae**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Demeanor; target up to {{bp}} individuals at any distance. **On a 10+**, targets make a genuine effort and arrive within the night. **On a 12+**, they drop everything and come immediately. **On a 6-**, targets feel the pull but can't act on it.

entries.name: Feral Weapons
entries.snippet: **When you extend your vampiric weapons into vicious talons or dagger-length fangs**, make a Hunger Check. For the scene, +2 Harm to unarmed attacks and all Harm dealt this way is Agg.

entries.name: Squirm
entries.snippet: Your flesh and bones become rubbery at will: squeeze through any gap at least 2 inches wide, escape grapples, restraints, coffins, car trunks, storm drains. No roll required. If forcibly extracted mid-squeeze, take 1 Agg. Harm.

entries.name: Weight of the Feather
entries.snippet: **You can reduce your effective mass and density to almost nothing at will.** Immune to fall damage, don't trigger pressure-sensitive devices, leave no footprints. Easily thrown, however; toggling mass is a Free Action.

entries.name: Masque of Death
entries.snippet: **When you let your body remember what it is**, make a Hunger Check. Assume the appearance of a genuine corpse (your choice of state); can't move but retain all senses, and only Agg. Harm affects you. May voluntarily enter Torpor (the only way to fool ***Sense the Unseen***). Lasts until you end it or sunset.

entries.name: Serpent's Kiss
entries.snippet: **When you will your fangs to lengthen and hollow like a venomous snake's**, make a Hunger Check. For the scene, any bite injects Vitae into the target (no extra Hunger cost) and optionally deals 2 additional Agg. Harm; counts as 1 Blood Bond exchange.

entries.name: Shapechange
entries.snippet: **When you take the form of a beast**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. You know up to {{1+bp}} animal shapes; available species scale with BP (common animals through supernatural forms at BP 5). **On a 10+**, seamless transformation; gain animal capabilities and Disciplines not requiring speech/hands. **On a 6-**, a Storyteller Move interrupts the transformation.

entries.name: The False Sip
entries.snippet: **When someone offers you blood you'd rather not take**, you prevent it from entering your system: no Blood Bond progress, no Harm/poison, no Hunger slaked. You must vomit it back up before scene ends or it enters your system normally.

entries.name: Vicissitude
entries.snippet: **When you reshape your own flesh and bone**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Resolve. Max active changes: {{bp}}, all permanent until reshaped. **On a 10+**, Hold 3; **on a 7–9**, Hold 2. Spend Hold 1-for-1: ***Osseous Weapons*** (+1 unarmed Harm), ***Subdermal Armor*** (always-on 1-Armor), ***Redistribution*** (swap two stat modifiers for the night), ***Swift Form*** (+1 Range band Movement/turn), or ***Reshape*** (alter your body/voice).

entries.name: Earth Meld
entries.snippet: **When you surrender your body to natural terrain** (soil, rock, sand; not concrete/asphalt), make a Hunger Check and roll +Resolve. **On a 10+**, sink fully in 1 turn with no trace; aware of surroundings within Close Range, immune to physical Harm, fire, and sunlight, rise at will, remain indefinitely. **On a 6-**, the earth rejects you violently; 1 Agg. Harm (Ignore-Armor).

entries.name: Fleshcrafting
entries.snippet: **When you spend an uninterrupted scene reshaping another's flesh and bone**, apply up to {{1+bp}} changes from ***Vicissitude***'s list. No roll required; changes permanent until reshaped.

entries.name: Visceral Absorption
entries.snippet: **When you press your hands to the ground near dead bodies and absorb the remains**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. Mortal/animal bodies only. **On a 10+**, absorb up to {{bp}} bodies, slake 1 Hunger each, faint residue remains. **On a 6-**, body rejected violently; slake nothing, evidence now on you.

entries.name: Bloodform
entries.snippet: **When you liquefy into sentient blood**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. Conventional weapons pass through; stakes can't find your heart; squeeze through any crack a liquid could pass. **On a 10+**, flow freely for 1 scene; only fire, sunlight, and supernatural attacks inflict Harm. **On a 6-**, uncontrolled splatter; spend next turn reassembling, Masquerade Clock advances.

entries.name: Face of the Victim
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from someone and take their likeness**, make a Hunger Check. Your flesh reshapes into a perfect physical copy (face, build, voice, mannerisms); Advantage on all rolls to impersonate them. Physical transformation, undetectable by ***Sense the Unseen***. Lasts until 5 Hunger, this Power is used again, or resculpted via ***Vicissitude***.

entries.name: Horrid Form
entries.snippet: **When you unleash your Beast's true shape**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. Choose up to {{bp}} changes from ***Vicissitude***'s list; these are free, last for the scene, and don't count against your ***Vicissitude*** limit. Automatic Masquerade breach. **On a 6-**, you transform but immediately reach 5 Hunger and Frenzy until scene ends.

entries.name: Master of Forms
entries.snippet: Take the form of any creature within ***Shapechange***'s limits, switching freely between shapes as a Free Action mid-scene or mid-combat. Each specific animal form always looks the same. If you have ***Metamorphosis***, Coterie members retain their current shapes when you switch.

entries.name: Metamorphosis
entries.snippet: **When you extend your beast-shape to your Coterie**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. While you're in animal form, your entire Coterie can take the same shape; they hold forms until dawn, exit voluntarily (Free Action), or are destroyed. **On a 10+**, seamless shift; everyone retains Discipline access. **On a 6-**, everyone takes 1 Agg. Harm, transforms into something unintended, and cannot exit the form willingly (and can't talk).

entries.name: Heart of Darkness
entries.snippet: **When you carve out your own heart**, take {{bp}} Agg. Harm. While removed: immune to staking, Humanity/Stains freeze (no Remorse Checks, can't gain or lose Humanity), Advantage on all Frenzy resistance rolls. If someone stakes the removed heart, you enter Torpor immediately; fire or sunlight dealing {{bp}} Agg. Harm to it means Final Death.

entries.name: Mist Form
entries.snippet: **When you dissolve into a billowing cloud of mist**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Resolve. **On a 10+**, fully dispersed for 1 scene; untouchable by physical attacks, pass through any air gap, only fire/sunlight/supernatural attacks Harm you, reform at will. **On a 6-**, become dark red Vitae mist; take {{bp}} Agg. Harm (Ignore-Armor), walking Masquerade violation.

entries.name: One With the Land
entries.snippet: **When you surrender to the earth and extend your awareness**, depth scales with Hunger Checks (1 for sensory overview of Distant Range for 1 scene, 2 to also focus on specific events/conversations, 3 to remain melded indefinitely). Must be on natural terrain. Immune to physical Harm, fire, and sunlight while melded; rising takes 1 full turn.

entries.name: Swarm
entries.snippet: **When your body dissolves into a living swarm** (species chosen permanently when learned), make 2 Hunger Checks. Conventional weapons can't meaningfully damage you; only fire and sunlight threaten. Each turn, deal {{1+bp}} Harm within Close Range (Agg. vs. mortals, Sup. vs. supernatural). If even 1 member survives, you fully regenerate at scene end. Masquerade Clock advances.

entries.name: The Unfettered Heart
entries.snippet: Your heart drifts freely in your chest; staking requires a **12+** on the staking roll, and even when staked you retain Movement. **When you wrench a stake from your own chest**, roll +Blood. **On a 10+**, stake free, gain +1 max Harm, +1 Hunger, and +1 Forward. If Hunger from this Power reaches 5: instant Frenzy, stake ripped out automatically, all max Harm healed, whoever staked you is your sole target.

entries.name: Sentinel's Perch
entries.snippet: **While touching stone, earth, concrete, or brick**, detect vibrations through the surface (footsteps, doors, heartbeats) and sense presence and approximate location of any creature moving within Close Range without rolling. With ***Skin of the Chameleon*** while perfectly still, awareness expands to the entire structure.

entries.name: Skin of the Chameleon
entries.snippet: Your stone skin automatically shifts color and texture to match surroundings. **When you *Slip Away* while perched on architecture, posing as a statue, or flying at night**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**. Observers not actively searching assume you're part of the scenery.

entries.name: Armor Terra
entries.snippet: **Each scene, you can convert up to {{bp*2}} incoming Agg. Harm to Sup. Harm.** Completely immune to fire (flames are cosmetic; prolonged exposure leaves visible charring until slumber).

entries.name: Rend and Hurl
entries.snippet: **When you tear a chunk from a building or the ground and hurl it at a target within Close Range**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. **On a 10+**, {{blood*2}} Harm plus choose 1: target loses their next turn, projectile smashes through cover, or 2 Harm to creatures at Hand Range from the target. **On a 6-**, material crumbles; 1 Sup. Harm from fragments, debris creates an environmental hazard.

entries.name: Clay Body
entries.snippet: **When you reshape your stone body to adapt**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Blood. **On a 10+**,  describe your transformation (extend reach, widen wingspan, compress frame, grow gripping surfaces) and gain +1 Forward on the next roll benefiting from the new form. Change lasts until scene ends. **On a 6-**, locked mid-transformation until scene ends.

entries.name: Shape the Edifice
entries.snippet: **When you press your hands against stone/concrete/brick and reshape it**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Resolve. **On a 10+**, reshape, open, seal, or restructure an area roughly double-doorway sized; changes are permanent and only tools, explosives, or supernatural abilities can undo them. **On a 6-**, stone resists or responds unpredictably.

entries.name: Flow Through the Mountain
entries.snippet: **When you press into earth, stone, concrete, or brick and let it swallow you**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. **On a 10+**, sink in and move through stone at usual pace for the scene; a visible ripple traces your path; emerge from any connected stone surface at will; immune to physical attacks while merged. **On a 6-**, partially merge and get stuck, vulnerable while embedded.

entries.name: Lurking Grotesque
entries.snippet: **When you meld into a stone surface and lie in wait**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Shadow. **On a 10+**, fully merged, invisible, silent, undetectable by mundane means; remain indefinitely while still. When a target comes within Hand Range, erupt for an automatic **12+** on **Dirty Your Claws**; target must **Stay Chill** or freeze in terror. **On a 6-**, partially embedded, position obvious.

entries.name: The Rock Within
entries.snippet: **Piercing/puncturing weapons** (bullets, knives, arrows, stakes) **deal half Harm to you** (rounded down, min 1). Staking automatically fails unless your Harm track is full and they have appropriate tools.

entries.name: Dark Statue
entries.snippet: **While perfectly still and in contact with stone or earth**, you are completely immune to sunlight and fire. Your body becomes the same material as your surface, and your mind is unreachable by any supernatural Power. Lasts as long as you remain motionless; any action ends it.

entries.name: Stone Legion
entries.snippet: **When you call on the memory of your kin**, make a Hunger Check and roll +Resolve with Advantage. **On a 10+**, {{bp}} stone constructs animate and fight alongside you for the scene, sharing your stats and attacking as unarmed **Dirty Your Claws** only. **On a 7–9**, half as many animate (min 1). **On a 6-**, stone stirs but refuses; rubble falls and surfaces become unstable.
